'''Godunov''' ({{langx|ru|Годунов}}) is a [[Russian language|Russian]] surname.

'''Godunov''' can refer to the following:

* {{ill|House of Godunov|ru|Годуновы}}, two [[Tsar#Russia|tsars of Russia]] and their kin:
** [[Boris Godunov|Tsar Boris Fyodorovich Godunov]] (1552–1605), a regent of Russia from 1584 to 1598 and then tsar from 1598 to 1605
** [[Feodor II of Russia|Tsar Fyodor Borisovich Godunov]] (1589–1605), son of tsar Boris Godunov, ruled less than a year as Feodor II after his father's death in 1605; murdered in June the same year
** [[Tsarevna Xenia Borisovna of Russia|Xenia Borisovna Godunova (later the Nun Olga)]] (1582–1622), daughter of tsar Boris Godunov
** [[Irina Godunova|Irina Feodorovna Godunova (later the Nun Alexandra)]] (1557–1603), wife of tsar Feodor I Ioannovich and sister of tsar Boris Godunov
* [[Sergei K. Godunov|Sergei Konstantinovich Godunov]] (1929–2023), a [[Russia]]n born [[mathematician]] who contributed to the [[finite volume method]] (FVM)
** [[Godunov's scheme]], a mathematical method suggested by Sergei Godunov in 1959
** [[Godunov's theorem]], a theorem proven by Sergei Godunov in 1954
* [[Alexander Godunov|Aleksandr Borisovich Godunov]] (1949–1995), a Russian ballet dancer and actor
* [[Petr Ivanovich Godunov]](?–1670), a Siberian governor
** [[Godunov map]], commissioned by Alexis of Russia on 15 November 1667 and named after Petr Ivanovich Godunov
* [[Godunov (TV series)|''Godunov'']], a Russian television drama TV series, centered upon the fate of the Godunov family
